observations: Photo 0 shows a Nikon-branded camera body with “Z fc” text on the top right area.
Photo 1 shows the lens mounted; the lens has a Nikon marking and visible focus/aperture markings, but the exact lens model name is not clearly readable.
Photo 2 shows the camera with accessories: a battery (Nikon-branded), a charger/battery charger unit, and multiple lens caps (front cap and two other caps/cover pieces).
No photo clearly shows the camera’s shutter count, sensor/IBIS status, or lens glass close-up for scratches/fungus.

claims.claim: Nikon z fc is a retro-inspired, slr-style mirrorless camera featuring a 20.9-megapixel aps-c...
claims.evidence: Photos show Nikon Z fc branding (photo 0) but do not show the sensor megapixel spec.
No photo shows shutter count/actuation screen or a shutter count report.

claims.claim: no fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: No close-up of the lens glass under light/angle; photos show the lens but not a definitive inspection for fungus/scratches.
Photo 2 shows Nikon-branded battery and a charger, but authenticity (original vs compatible) is not provable from the image alone.
No service history, serial/repair documentation, or internal inspection is shown.

risks.risk: Shutter count may be higher than stated (affects value and expected lifespan).
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of shutter count from-camera or from a shutter count app/report for this exact serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used Nikon Z fc with unknown/high shutter count (worst case for value).

risks.risk: Lens may have fungus, haze, or scratches not visible in these angles (affects image quality).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the lens glass (front and rear if accessible) in strong side light, plus a short test shot showing contrast/flare.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens with potential optical issues (worst case: treat as not guaranteed clean).

risks.risk: Lens model/condition is unclear; could be a different kit lens or have mechanical issues (focus ring, aperture, zoom).
risks.proof: Photo of the lens name/model ring text (or lens front ring) and a short video showing autofocus and aperture response.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic kit-lens bundle with unknown lens model and condition.

risks.risk: Battery/charger authenticity and battery health (capacity) are unknown; battery may be degraded.
risks.proof: Photo of battery label with model/part number and a battery health/cycle count screenshot (or a test showing full charge and runtime).
risks.if_unproven: Price as battery health unknown (worst case: reduced runtime).

risks.risk: Camera may have faults (IBIS, buttons, EVF/LCD, overheating, sensor issues) not shown in static photos.
risks.proof: Video of power-on, menu navigation, EVF/LCD switching, and a live view + autofocus test; include a photo of the sensor dust check (bright light/white wall at high f-stop).
risks.if_unproven: Price as fully untested/unknown condition (worst case: assume potential faults until proven).

proof_requests: Send a shutter count screenshot/report tied to the camera’s serial number.
Send sharp close-up photos of the lens front and rear glass in side light (to confirm no fungus/scratches).
Send the exact lens model name/part number (photo of lens markings) and confirm what lens is included.
Send photos of the camera serial number and a short video test: autofocus + EVF/LCD + button/menu response.
Send battery health info (cycles/capacity) or a runtime test after full charge.
response.reason: The photos confirm a Nikon Z fc body and show some accessories, but key value drivers (shutter count, lens condition, exact lens model, and functional health) are not provable from the provided images. To price confidently, the decisive proof items above are needed.
